study type: Retrospective review and systematic literature review
exposure: Surgical management (VP/CP shunt vs. repair alone)
cohort: Patients with co-existing Dandy Walker malformation (DWM) and occipital encephalocele (OE), consisting of 5 patients from a personal series managed between 2012 and 2024 and 79 cases from a systematic literature review.
finding: VP/CP shunt is essential in surgical management, leading to a better prognosis compared to repair alone, with giant size of OE/OM and associated anomalies also influencing long-term outcomes.
